messages:
Priya: hey team, starting Mon — quick security/onboarding Qs: will my contractor Mac be enrolled in company MDM automatically? also have an upcoming week in the air‑gapped lab — any special steps for BIOS/firmware lockdown or approval? and last: how do I get a guest wifi voucher for the visiting contractor on day 2?
Alex: welcome! for contractor Macs we still require MDM enrollment. IT will ship a config profile and a short enrollment link. if you already have the device, please run `Profiles` > install the 'Redwood MDM' profile otherwise we'll provision before shipping.
Priya: I have the laptop already (personal, company reimbursing). can i enroll personal device into MDM or do i need a loaner?
Alex: you can enroll personal devices if you accepted the BYOD agreement. send serial number (or run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial"`) to IT and we’ll open the ticket. note: BYOD gets standard access but no HSM/airgap privileges unless you request an exception.
Tara: @Priya for the air‑gapped lab we require a vetted hardware posture: disk encryption, secure boot/firmware up‑to‑date, and a signed exception from security. we usually ask folks to hand devices to physical security for a quick image scan before access.
Priya: ah ok — is there a form or process for that exception?
Tara: yes — submit a compliance exception via https://redwood.co/compliance-requests (choose "airgapped-lab"). include serial, OS version, FileVault status, and the justification (brief). SLA is ~48 hours for review.
People Ops: For badge/guest wifi: request a visitor voucher in the office tools page (Onsite -> Visitor Access). we can pre-book a foam badge and a 24hr guest wifi voucher. if you give ETA and visitor name we’ll preprint.
Priya: thanks — do I need to enable FileVault now or will IT reimage and enable during provisioning?
Alex: enable FileVault before bringing it in if you want to keep personal data. if IT reimages we wipe the drive and enable company FileVault keys. if you enroll BYOD and keep your data, enabling FileVault beforehand is required.
Priya: understood. one more: phishing sim & security training schedule — when does that kick in for new hires?
Tara: training assigned day 1 via LMS (Security Foundations). phishing sims start after week 1 and are low frequency while you're new. complete the LMS within 7 days to avoid automated reminders.
IT Bot: Ticket created: IT-4521 — 'MDM enrollment request for Priya' (owner: Alex). ETA: 2 business days.
Priya: awesome, thanks. i'll send serial + visitor ETA today. appreciate the quick answers :slightly_smiling_face:
